description: This file contains a benchmark class for testing grain communication patterns using Orleans framework with fanout patterns across multiple silos. It sets up silos, configures clustering, and performs benchmarks on grain ping operations.

classes.name: FanoutBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class that sets up Orleans silos and clients, and measures grain communication performance using a fanout pattern.

methods.name: FanoutBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor initializing silos and client environment for benchmarking.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that performs a Ping on the grain.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Continuously pings the grain in an asynchronous loop (not marked as benchmark).

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs a graceful shutdown of all hosts and clients.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and event handlers when the benchmark is disposed.

methods.name: CancelPressed
methods.description: Handles console cancel events to exit the application.
